description:
Designed with modern lifestyles in mind, our two-bedroom apartments at New Fountainbridge strike the perfect balance of style, flexibility and comfort. Fully furnished and finished to a high specification, every home includes a king-sized main bedroom, a versatile second bedroom for guests, family or home working, and an open-plan living area complete with a Bosch integrated kitchen (washer dryer, oven/hob, microwave and fridge freezer). 

Generous layouts maximise space and natural light, while thoughtful details like ample storage help keep life organised. Residents also enjoy landscaped gardens, peaceful canal-side courtyards and a professional concierge service, alongside secure parcel storage, cycle facilities and resident perks through the app. Secure parking is also available at an additional cost. 

The Union Canal setting brings calm to your daily routine, while Haymarket Station, Fountain Park, Bruntsfield cafés, and Grassmarket nightlife are all within walking distance. With the best of Edinburgh on your doorstep, these homes make it easy to enjoy both workday convenience and weekend culture. 

LARN Number: 2505002 

Tenancy: Private Residential Tenancy 

Deposit: A 5 week security deposit is required. A deposit alternative option is also available.
keyFeatures: Contemporary two-bedroom homes with open-plan layouts
Versatile second bedroom for guests, home office or family
Bosch integrated kitchen with washer dryer, oven/hob, microwave & fridge freezer
Some duplexes feature balconies, others Juliettes or terraces
Landscaped gardens, courtyards, concierge service & parcel store
